kpis.name: Verified collected revenue
kpis.definition: Payment-provider-confirmed collected payments, separated by currency and refunds
kpis.target: Set by owner; never infer from leads

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.definition: Collected revenue minus direct delivery costs, divided by collected revenue

kpis.name: Qualified lead rate
kpis.definition: Human-verified suitable leads divided by discovered listings

kpis.name: Proposal win rate
kpis.definition: Accepted proposals divided by submitted proposals

kpis.name: On-time delivery
kpis.definition: Accepted deliverables completed by the approved deadline

kpis.name: First-pass QA rate
kpis.definition: Deliverables passing agreed checks without material rework

kpis.name: Customer satisfaction
kpis.target: Target at least 4.5/5 when enough responses exist

kpis.name: Refund and dispute rate
kpis.definition: Refunded/disputed payment value compared with collected payment value

kpis.name: Security incidents
kpis.definition: Confirmed unauthorized access or data exposure incidents

kpis.name: Agent task reliability
kpis.definition: Successful valid tasks divided by assigned tasks, excluding properly escalated tasks
kpis.target: Measured by role; no hiring on self-reported scores

rules: Do not fabricate data or use vanity metrics as proof of revenue.
Show sample sizes, date range, source, and data freshness with every KPI.
Targets are reviewed by a human and may be changed with a recorded rationale.
Never reward agents for unsafe actions, spam, fake reviews, or misleading claims.
